title: Helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rotor blades -->
  <rect x='10' y='16' width='80' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#7ec8ff'/>
  <rect x='46' y='18' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b0e0ff'/>
  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='24' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#90b8d8'/>
  <!-- main body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='28' ry='18' fill='#ffc55c'/>
  <!-- body edge shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='28' ry='18' fill='none' stroke='#e8952e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- tail boom -->
  <rect x='72' y='46' width='20' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <rect x='72' y='45' width='20' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffc55c'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <rect x='88' y='38' width='4' height='22' rx='2' fill='#7ec8ff'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='49' r='3' fill='#b0e0ff'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='44' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#2a4a6a'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='42' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5a9acf'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='40' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#9fd0f5'/>
  <!-- stripe -->
  <rect x='24' y='56' width='52' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#e86040'/>
  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='28' y='72' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a0a8b8'/>
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='4' height='6' fill='#8890a0'/>
  <rect x='62' y='68' width='4' height='6' fill='#8890a0'/>
  <!-- cheerful eye dot on window -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
